note: Break the Citadel Chain event for GraveGain2dB MMO (games lane, v2-native). Public breach event: many 4-player authoritative rooms on ONE shared seed relay objectives to a global bar, then unlock the world boss. Solo play stays fully available when the MMO layer is offline. ASCII only.

bossUnlock.rule: relay legs complete (every front >= 20% of threshold) THEN boss damage >= threshold

killRule.summary: total relay damage >= threshold AND each of the 4 fronts >= 20% of threshold, then boss damage >= threshold

modifiers.effect: Hourly breach window: +25% objective value in gravegain2dB for 10 minutes
Relay fronts deal back 10% less; squad records tracked per front

rewards.detail: Event loot cache per verified relay front (idempotent redeem)
Top-share verified contributors earn the chainbreaker title
Mid-share verified contributors earn the ward-cleaver title
Base-share verified contributors earn the linkbearer title
